verdict.rationale: Pika's own llms.txt documents an official "Pika MCP" that connects to ChatGPT, Claude, OpenClaw and other MCP-compatible agents. The site also describes using its creative apps and models "without leaving your conversation," and a probe confirms the llms.txt is live. missing for 10: setup/connection documentation (endpoint, auth, transport), list of exposed tools, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.
